room_rent.note: Limit as per Policy Schedule; higher SI options (75L, 100L) may have no cap - confirm in schedule

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in wording

sub_limits.note: Modern treatments sub-limited to 50% of SI; domiciliary capped at 10% of SI; other specific limits per schedule

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible; hospital daily cash has 48-hr deductible

ped_waiting.note: Wording states 36 or 24 months as per plan; Optimum Plus assumed 24 months (confirm in schedule)

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month list (cataract, hernia, etc.), 24-month list, 36-month list also apply

maternity.note: Family floater only; max 2 deliveries lifetime; limit per schedule; includes child care, newborn vaccinations, stem cell banking allowance

cumulative_bonus.note: Optional CB Enhancer available: 25%/yr up to 150% of SI

restoration.note: Restored SI usable only for different illness/disease not claimed in current year; cannot exceed Basic SI; unutilised amount lapses

domiciliary.note: Min 3 days treatment; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.)

ayush.note: Inpatient only (min 24 hrs); OPD/day care AYUSH excluded; no pre/post-hosp AYUSH

organ_donor.note: Screening and harvesting expenses; donor pre/post-hosp not covered

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; limit as per Policy Schedule; air ambulance via emergency assistance (cashless, 150km+ from home)

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed procedures including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: No consumables cover mentioned in wording

global_cover.note: Emergency care outside India; reimbursement in INR; max 180 days/yr; PED excluded for first 36 months

notable_exclusions: STDs/HIV, dental (unless accident), spectacles/hearing aids, external prosthetics, external congenital anomaly, OPD (except pre/post-hosp)
optional_riders: CB Enhancer (up to 150% SI), OPD cover, Critical Illness & PA cover, Worldwide cover, Adventure Sports cover
